ValidationRule.description: Home Loan opportunities must have Loan Amount, Property Value, and Annual Income populated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Loan_Type__c, "Home"), OR( ISBLANK(Loan_Amount__c), ISBLANK(Property_Value__c), ISBLANK(Annual_Income__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Home Loan requires Loan Amount, Property Value, and Annual Income.
